name: B10-0436/2026 – § 8 – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the pilot project on European Schools Alliances
part_text: 8.Invites the Commission, in cooperation with the Member States, to promote synergies between the pilot and existing EU funding programmes and initiatives, such as Erasmus+, national and regional partnership plans, the European Social Fund Plus, and the Youth Guarantee; calls on the Commission to ensure that any new structures established under the European Schools Alliances provide clear and demonstrable added value compared with existing Erasmus+ instruments, are cost-efficient and respect the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality, avoiding unnecessary duplication and administrative burdens;
